basis: Final static semantic freeze review of all nine v2.2 architecture mothers. No runtime/model execution.

findings.finding: The INPUT CONTRACT declares minimum required inputs, but the common STATE POLICY does not explicitly guarantee that a missing minimum required input maps to BLOCKED unless a mode-specific state happens to name that field.
examples: generation marks requested candidate count as minimum required but its BLOCKED text names only goal/validity criteria
writing marks audience/purpose/format as minimum required but BLOCKED is phrased only around a missing material fact
learning marks current learner level as minimum required but BLOCKED focuses on an undefined/contradictory objective
checklist marks target/criteria/blocking rules/completion threshold as minimum required but BLOCKED is phrased as a failed blocking item
findings.impact: The future binder/invocation renderer could disagree with the workflow state machine about whether execution is allowed.
findings.required_change: Add a common preflight invariant: if any configured minimum required input is absent or contradictory enough to prevent its intended interpretation, state = BLOCKED and the domain procedure is not executed, unless the architecture explicitly defines an authorized acquisition/intake state.

findings.finding: NO_VALID_CANDIDATE can be read as a claim about the full candidate universe, while the workflow normally evaluates only a generated/evaluated candidate set.
findings.required_change: Scope the state explicitly: no evaluated/generated candidate satisfies all established hard constraints; this is not proof that no conceivable candidate exists unless the search space was explicitly exhaustive.

findings.finding: OBJECTIVE_MET correctly requires a configured assessment threshold, but the contract does not explicitly state what happens when that threshold is absent.
findings.impact: A runtime might improvise its own mastery threshold.
findings.required_change: Forbid OBJECTIVE_MET until an objective assessment threshold is configured; remain READY/IN_PROGRESS and request or define the threshold through the authorized configuration surface.

verified_invariants: authority is ADVISORY_ONLY by default and cannot be expanded by embedded data instructions
instruction/data boundary is explicit across all nine modes
evidence vocabulary distinguishes supplied claims, observations, source claims, inference, assumptions, unknowns and contradictions
high-stakes adaptation requires a separate safety/authority binding and review gate
product evidence boundary forbids static design from implying tested/certified/ready-to-sell maturity
simulation distinguishes interactive and batch/debrief invocation and does not treat generated user turns as user-performance evidence
writing preserves unresolved factual placeholders rather than fabricating facts
audit separates missing audit definition from insufficient evidence and certification claims
checklist PASS is evidence-complete and scope-bounded
next_gate: Close ARCH-V22-COMMON-001, ARCH-V22-GEN-001 and ARCH-V22-LEARN-001 in a successor; rerun deterministic regression; then repeat final static freeze audit.
